---
title: "New York Air Quality"
format:
  dashboard:
    # One theme per colour mode is what gives the page its dark-mode toggle.
    # Colours for both come from _brand.yml; drift.scss is the look.
    theme:
      light: [brand, drift.scss]
      dark: [brand, drift.scss]
    include-after-body: _ornaments.html
    orientation: rows
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(brandkit)

# Themes every plot from _brand.yml and keeps them in step with the dark-
# mode toggle. No plot below carries any styling of its own.
brand_quarto_setup(shiny = TRUE)

# Sample data - replace with your own. airquality is built into R: daily
# readings in New York, May to September 1973.
aq <- airquality
aq$Date  <- as.Date(sprintf("1973-%02d-%02d", aq$Month, aq$Day))
aq$Month <- factor(month.name[aq$Month], levels = month.name[5:9])
```

# {.sidebar}

```{r}
checkboxGroupInput(
  "months", "Months",
  choices  = levels(aq$Month),
  selected = levels(aq$Month)
)
sliderInput("temp", "Temperature (°F)", min = min(aq$Temp), max = max(aq$Temp),
            value = range(aq$Temp), step = 1)
```

# Dashboard

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average temperature"

textOutput("temp_avg")
```

## Row {height="35%"}

```{r}
#| title: "By month"
tableOutput("monthly")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
d <- reactive({
  req(input$months)
  aq[aq$Month %in% input$months & aq$Temp %in% seq(input$temp[1], input$temp[2]), ]
})

output$temp_avg  <- renderText({ req(nrow(d()) > 0); paste(round(mean(d()$Temp)), "°F") })
output$ozone_avg <- renderText({ req(nrow(d()) > 0); paste(round(mean(d()$Ozone, na.rm = TRUE)), "ppb") })
output$wind_avg  <- renderText({ req(nrow(d()) > 0); paste(round(mean(d()$Wind), 1), "mph") })

output$temp_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(nrow(d()) > 0)
  ggplot(d(), aes(Date, Temp, group = Month)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", formula = y ~ x) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°F)")
})

output$ozone_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(nrow(d()) > 0)
  ggplot(na.omit(d()), aes(Temp, Ozone, color = Month)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Temperature (°F)", y = "Ozone (ppb)", color = NULL)
})

output$monthly <- renderTable({
  req(nrow(d()) > 0)
  m <- aggregate(cbind(Temp, Ozone, Wind) ~ Month, d(), mean,
                 na.rm = TRUE, na.action = na.pass)
  data.frame(
    Month = m$Month,
    `Temperature (°F)` = round(m$Temp),
    `Ozone (ppb)`      = round(m$Ozone),
    `Wind (mph)`       = format(round(m$Wind, 1), nsmall = 1),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}, striped = TRUE, width = "100%", align = "lrrr", digits = 0)
```
